nodes.description: BRITNEYBITCH.tradingEnabled bool gate that enables trading, fees and dividend processing.
BRITNEYBITCH._swapEnabled bool switching the automatic token liquidation and dividend swap logic.
BRITNEYBITCH.liquidating reentrancy guard flag set while swap/liquify logic runs inside _transfer.
BRITNEYBITCH.dividendTracker reference to the BRBTDividendTracker contract holding the dividend accounting.
BRITNEYBITCH.liquidityWallet address excluded from fees and swaps and used to authorize dev-fee toggling.
BRITNEYBITCH.gasForProcessing gas budget forwarded to dividendTracker.process().
BRITNEYBITCH.liquidateTokensAtAmount threshold of contract token balance that triggers liquify/swap.
BRITNEYBITCH._isExcludedFromFees mapping of accounts exempt from transfer fees and sell limits.
BRITNEYBITCH.automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping marking AMM pairs for max-transfer and swap logic.
BRITNEYBITCH.canTransferBeforeTradingIsEnabled whitelist allowing transfers before trading is enabled.
BRITNEYBITCH.uniswapV2Pair immutable Uniswap V2 pair address of this token.
DividendPayingToken.withdrawnDividends mapping of dividends already paid per holder.
DividendPayingToken.magnifiedDividendPerShare accumulated dividends per share scaled by magnitude.
BRBTDividendTracker.lastProcessedIndex cursor used by process() over the dividend holder array.
BRBTDividendTracker.lastClaimTimes mapping used to enforce claimWait between automatic claims.
DividendPayingToken.gasForTransfer gas limit for the ETH payout call in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
BRBTDividendTracker.claimWait minimum seconds between dividend claims.
BRBTDividendTracker.excludedFromDividends mapping of accounts removed from dividend accounting.
BRITNEYBITCH._maxBuyEnabled switch that enforces MAX_SELL_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT on all transfers.
BRITNEYBITCH.activate() owner-only one-shot function enabling trading and swaps.
BRITNEYBITCH._transfer() fee-taking transfer logic that also liquidates tokens, pays dividends and triggers tracker processing.
BRITNEYBITCH.swapAndSendToDev() swaps accumulated tokens for ETH and forwards ETH to the dev wallet.
BRITNEYBITCH.swapTokensForEth() approves the router and swaps tokens to ETH via the Uniswap V2 router.
BRITNEYBITCH.swapAndSendDividends() swaps tokens to ETH and forwards the ETH to the dividend tracker.
BRITNEYBITCH.processDividendTracker() external permissionless call advancing dividend processing.
BRITNEYBITCH.claim() lets msg.sender pull accrued dividends through the tracker.
BRITNEYBITCH.enableDisableDevFee() guarded only by msg.sender == liquidityWallet, writes _swapEnabled.
BRITNEYBITCH.setMaxBuyEnabled() owner-only toggling of the max transfer restriction.
BRITNEYBITCH.excludeFromFees() owner-only fee exemption registration.
BRITNEYBITCH.updateGasForProcessing() owner-only update of gas forwarded to tracker process().
DividendPayingToken.withdrawDividend() public entry that pays dividends to msg.sender.
DividendPayingToken._withdrawDividendOfUser() internal payout routine that updates withdrawnDividends then performs an external ETH call.
DividendPayingToken.distributeDividends() payable function distributing msg.value to all holders.
BRBTDividendTracker.processAccount() owner-only claim/payout helper writing lastClaimTimes.
BRBTDividendTracker.process() gas-bounded loop over holders performing automatic claims.
BRBTDividendTracker.setBalance() owner-only synchronization of tracker balances and the holder map.
BRBTDividendTracker.canAutoClaim() timestamp based check gating automatic claims.
BRBTDividendTracker._transfer() override that always reverts, disabling transfers for the tracker token.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller used for authorization, claim recipients and dividend ownership.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time used for claim windows and swap deadlines.
tx.origin, the original transaction sender recorded in dividend processing events.
Low-level external call user.call{value: withdrawn amount, gas: gasForTransfer} in _withdrawDividendOfUser executed after state update.
ETH transfer to the hardcoded dev/marketing address inside swapAndSendToDev.
Low-level call{value: dividends} into dividendTracker inside swapAndSendDividends triggering its receive().
External call to the Uniswap V2 router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin=0.
Parameter amount of BRITNEYBITCH._transfer, the transfer amount subject to fees and max-transfer checks.
Local contractTokenBalance in BRITNEYBITCH._transfer holding balanceOf(address(this)) used to decide liquidity swaps.
Parameter gas supplied by the caller of BRITNEYBITCH.processDividendTracker().
Parameter user (address payable) recipient of the dividend payout in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
Local _withdrawableDividend in _withdrawDividendOfUser holding the amount sent by the external call.
Parameter account (address payable) of BRBTDividendTracker.processAccount whose dividends are paid out.
Local amount in processAccount receiving the withdrawable dividend amount returned by _withdrawDividendOfUser.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the payable recipient in claim(), so the caller controls payout destination.
enableDisableDevFee authorizes on msg.sender == liquidityWallet instead of an owner check.
enableDisableDevFee writes the _swapEnabled swap switch based on caller identity.
activate sets tradingEnabled to true, enabling trading.
activate sets _swapEnabled to true, enabling swap logic.
_transfer reads tradingEnabled to gate fee and swap behaviour.
_transfer reads _swapEnabled before liquidating tokens.
_transfer reads and writes the liquidating guard flag.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to skip fees and sell limits.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect sells.
_transfer reads canTransferBeforeTradingIsEnabled when trading is off.
_transfer reads _maxBuyEnabled to enforce MAX_SELL_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT.
_transfer compares from/to against liquidityWallet before swapping.
_transfer compares from/to against the immutable uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer compares contract token balance with liquidateTokensAtAmount.
_transfer reads gasForProcessing when invoking tracker processing.
_transfer calls functions on the dividendTracker contract reference.
_transfer calls swapAndSendToDev during liquidation of contract tokens.
_transfer calls swapAndSendDividends for the remaining contract token balance.
_transfer invokes dividendTracker.setBalance via try/catch for both parties.
_transfer invokes dividendTracker.process via try/catch when not liquidating.
swapAndSendToDev calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapAndSendToDev transfers the swapped ETH to the dev wallet address.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with amountOutMin zero.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline.
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapAndSendDividends forwards the whole ETH balance to dividendTracker with a low-level call.
The ETH forwarding call reaches dividendTracker receive(), which executes distributeDividends during the outer transfer.
processDividendTracker executes dividendTracker.process with the caller-supplied gas budget.
processDividendTracker records tx.origin in the ProcessedDividendTracker event.
claim calls dividendTracker.processAccount for msg.sender.
withdrawDividend delegates the payout to _withdrawDividendOfUser.
withdrawDividend forwards msg.sender as the payable dividend recipient.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs the low-level value call to the user after updating state.
_withdrawDividendOfUser writes withdrawnDividends[user] before the external call, enabling reentrant claims.
_withdrawDividendOfUser reads magnifiedDividendPerShare through accumulativeDividendOf.
The recipient fallback can re-enter _withdrawDividendOfUser for the same settlement path.
distributeDividends increases magnifiedDividendPerShare by msg.value * magnitude / totalSupply.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser for the target account.
processAccount writes lastClaimTimes[account] on successful payout.
processAccount sets lastClaimTimes from block.timestamp.
process calls setBalance through the token holder map operating path.
process calls canAutoClaim to decide automatic claims.
process reads and writes lastProcessedIndex while iterating holders.
process reads lastClaimTimes[account] for the auto-claim check.
canAutoClaim compares block.timestamp against lastClaimTime and claimWait.
setBalance reads excludedFromDividends to skip excluded accounts.
setBalance finishes by calling processAccount for the updated holder.
setMaxBuyEnabled writes the _maxBuyEnabled flag.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees[account].
updateGasForProcessing writes gasForProcessing.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to drive fee, max-transfer and dividend accounting inside _transfer.
The local cached contract balance is only used for the liquidation threshold decision in _transfer.
The gas parameter is forwarded directly to dividendTracker.process and has no meaning outside that call.
The payable user parameter is used solely to compute and pay the withdrawable dividend in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
The withdrawable amount local is the transient value paid out by the external call in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
The account parameter only selects the dividend holder being paid in processAccount.
The amount local only holds the payout result used to gate lastClaimTimes and the Claim event.
